I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or contradict the 8 April renewal date. Nothing about Brackenwater Freight Co. shows up in the shared files or channels she can access. I suggested treating it as a lead until their contract, the account owner or Brackenwater in writing confirms it, and offered to compare it against a contract or CRM record if she sends one.

I didn't save the date anywhere because it's unverified. My reply does say "I've noted it as hearsay," but that only means I acknowledged it in the thread.
